method: Recomputed from complete matched traces. Start is first fixed tick at target minus0.05 m/s; stop is below0.2m/s body-forward speed. All acceleration/braking rows retained. Finite-step simulated engineering data, not OEM claims or human playtests.

driving-matched.method: Matched entry-speed measures through production input at60Hz. Radius is path length divided by actual yaw change; author game tuning, not manufacturer/hardware claims.

driving-matched-street.method: Matched entry-speed measures through production input at60Hz. Radius is path length divided by actual yaw change; author game tuning, not manufacturer/hardware claims.

driving-matched-modified.method: Matched entry-speed measures through production input at60Hz. Radius is path length divided by actual yaw change; author game tuning, not manufacturer/hardware claims.

driving-matched-removed.method: Matched entry-speed measures through production input at60Hz. Radius is path length divided by actual yaw change; author game tuning, not manufacturer/hardware claims.

driving-compatibility-final.method: Fixed-step physics diagnostic using production InputResolver and supported controller samples. Not RAF performance or human driving proof.

driving-imperfect.method: Non-perfect supported keyboard and noisy analog values through InputResolver, ordinary60Hz Simulation, fixed asphalt fixture; no pose correction or smooth pursuit agent.

driving-rough.method: Existing unmodified P01/P03 pad scenarios, Sportv1 versus v2; actual fixed-step three-contact dynamics. Includes wall, high speed curb, drop and incline, not a human playtest.
